blocks.text:
Arrival at Rio de Janeiro airport.

Your driver will be waiting in the arrivals area with a sign.

Transfer to your hotel.

If you arrive during daylight hours, you can already see green hills, rocky mountains, palm trees and bays along the way.

After dark, the lights of residential neighbourhoods and favelas appear on the hillsides.

After check-in, the rest of the day is free.

Head out for a walk around the city or spend some time by the ocean.

There is no scheduled excursion on the first day, so you can set your own pace after the flight.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word paragraphs 67–69 confirm arrival and transfer but omit the detailed RU account of the sign, daytime and night-time views, free time and arrival-day pace.
